# routeros_system_certificate_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_certificate_settings" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `builtin_trust_store` (String) RouterOS provided CA certificates.
- `crl_download` (Boolean) Auto CRL download and update.
- `crl_store` (String) CRL storage location. Possible values: `ram`, `system`.
- `crl_use` (Boolean) Perform CRL checking when validating trust chain.
- `current_defaults` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_system_certificate_settings.settings .
```
